radio.rebootingWifiConfig: Rebooting {{info}} to apply its Wi-Fi settings
radio.rebootingReconnectRequestedWifiConfig: The radio is rebooting to apply its Wi-Fi settings. Meshloom reconnects automatically.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wifi.intro: The radio's own Wi-Fi interface (companion firmware 1.18 or later, built with Wi-Fi). Changes apply after the radio reboots.
wifi.checkFailed: Could not check the radio's Wi-Fi settings.
wifi.ssidHelp: The network the radio joins. Spaces count: it is sent exactly as typed.
wifi.storedHelp: Stored credentials let the flasher update this radio without retyping the Wi-Fi password.
wifi.setUpHelp: The radio has no Wi-Fi network name yet. It starts Wi-Fi only once one is stored.
wifi.dialogStoreTitle: Store the Wi-Fi credentials in the radio
wifi.dialogIntro: Meshloom sends these to the radio and checks them. It never keeps the password.
wifi.passwordRequired: Type the password, or tick "Open network".
wifi.passwordTooLong: The password is too long (63 bytes at most).
wifi.passwordShort: Short for a Wi-Fi password: WPA needs at least 8 characters. Kept as typed.
wifi.ssidInvalid: The network name must be 1 to 32 bytes, without control characters.
wifi.ssidReserved: A network literally named "(not set)" cannot be used: the radio prints that when no name is set.
wifi.wrongPasswordWarning: A wrong password, or "Open network" ticked for a protected network, stops the radio joining Wi-Fi after its next reboot.
wifi.saved: Wi-Fi credentials stored in the radio
wifi.savedOpen: Open network stored in the radio
wifi.disableConfirmBody: The radio stops its Wi-Fi interface at its next reboot.
wifi.disableLater: Turn off at the next reboot
wifi.confirmRebootBody: The new Wi-Fi settings apply once the radio restarts. Meshloom reconnects on its own.
wifi.tcpWarning: Meshloom reaches this radio over the network: changing the Wi-Fi network or turning Wi-Fi off can make it unreachable. Reconnect it over USB or Bluetooth if that happens.
wifi.storePartialWarning: The radio may hold incomplete Wi-Fi credentials. Check them over USB or Bluetooth before rebooting it.
wifi.storeIncompleteWarning: Storing the Wi-Fi credentials for "{{ssid}}" was interrupted. Store them again before rebooting the radio.
wifi.switchTcpBody: The radio is on Wi-Fi at {{ip}}. Switch Meshloom to TCP {{ip}}:{{port}}?
wifi.switchTcpToast: The radio is on Wi-Fi at {{ip}}
wifi.switchTcpRevertTimeout: Meshloom could not reach the radio over TCP.
wifi.loadFailed: Could not read the radio's Wi-Fi settings.

toast.radioRebootingWifiConfig: Radio rebooting to apply its Wi-Fi settings

errors.no_previous_transport: There is no previous connection to go back to.
errors.radio_identity_gate_open: A different radio identity is waiting for your decision: adopt or reject it first.
errors.wifi_unsupported: This radio has no companion CLI or no Wi-Fi interface.
errors.wifi_cli_timeout: The radio did not answer in time. Try again.
errors.wifi_cli_rejected: The radio refused the Wi-Fi command.
errors.wifi_cli_error: The radio gave an unexpected answer to the Wi-Fi command.
errors.wifi_store_unverified: The radio did not keep the Wi-Fi credentials as sent; the previous values were restored.
errors.wifi_store_partial: Storing the Wi-Fi credentials was interrupted: the radio may hold incomplete ones. Check them over USB or Bluetooth before rebooting it.
errors.wifi_radio_changed: The connected radio changed; this question was about another radio.

wifiPrompt.title: Store this radio's Wi-Fi password
wifiPrompt.reason: Meshloom can store the Wi-Fi credentials in the radio itself. That lets the flasher update this radio without retyping Wi-Fi credentials. Meshloom never keeps the password.
wifiPrompt.dismiss: Don't ask again for this radio
wifiPrompt.stored: Wi-Fi credentials for "{{ssid}}" stored in the radio
wifiPrompt.storedOpen: Open network "{{ssid}}" stored in the radio
